intro.title: This one's a big update
intro.body: Swipe to meet the new AI Coach and a few changes you'll run into.

ai-coach.title: Meet Your New AI Coach
ai-coach.body: Tap the middle button to chat. The coach plans around what you already have, and one tick adds a suggestion. Long-press it for quick add.

ai-memory.title: Your Coach Remembers What Matters
ai-memory.body: Tell it about your habits once and it keeps them in mind next time. To turn this off, go to Settings → AI Memory.

add-review.title: Add Has Moved to the Top Right
add-review.body: Tap + at the top right of Home to add a task. Its old spot is now Review, with a red dot when a new letter arrives.

feedback.title: Say Your Feedback Out Loud
feedback.body: In Settings → Share Feedback, hold to talk instead of typing. We read every message.

widget.title: Today's Tasks, Right on Your Home Screen
widget.body: Add the home-screen widget to see today's date and how many tasks you have at a glance. Chinese task names no longer get cut off.
